title: My Profile
subtitle: Manage your account settings and preferences

header.title: Profile
header.photo_invalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image
header.photo_too_large: Choose an image smaller than 5 MB
header.photo_error: Couldn't upload your photo. Try again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Customize your event discovery experience
preferences.location_note: Events near this location will be prioritized in your feed
preferences.categories_note: Select your interests to get personalized event recommendations

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Manage how you hear from us
notifications.event_reminders_desc: Get notified before events you're attending
notifications.event_updates_desc: Changes to events you're attending or following
notifications.promos_desc: Special offers, featured events, and platform updates
notifications.note: Important account and security notifications will always be sent regardless of these settings.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Manage your account settings
account.help_support_desc: Get help and find answers to your questions
account.delete_account_desc: Permanently delete your account and data
account.delete_modal_desc: This action cannot be undone. All your data, tickets, and event history will be permanently deleted.

organizer_profile.no_upcoming_desc: This organizer doesn't have any upcoming events at the moment.

organization.title: Organization
organization.hint: Shown wherever you appear as the organizer, in place of your personal name.
organization.logo_error: Couldn't upload the logo. Try again.

find_friends.title: Find your people
find_friends.body: See who you know on Tikèm. More friends, better picks, and you can invite them to events.

posters.title: Your events
posters.empty_body: Events you get tickets to will show up here as a poster wall.

view_as.title: View as
view_as.tip_organizer: Organizer opens your events, sales and payouts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.edit_profile_desc: Name, phone, bio and social links
settings.privacy_desc: Who sees your profile and the events you go to

following.title: Following
following.subtitle: Organizers you follow. Followers stay a count, for privacy.
following.empty_body: Organizers you follow will show up here.
following.load_error: Couldn't load the organizers you follow.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Your questions to organizers and their answers
messages.privacy: Your email address and phone number stay private.
messages.closed: This conversation has reached its message limit.
messages.awaiting: You have sent several messages in a row. You can write again once the organizer answers.
messages.error_awaiting: Give the organizer a chance to answer before writing again.
messages.error_limit: This conversation has reached its message limit.
messages.error_too_long: That message is too long. Trim it a little.
messages.error_generic: Could not send your message. Try again.
messages.empty_body: Questions you send to an organizer from an event page, and their answers, show up here.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: You control who sees your activity. Unless you change it, your friends can see the events you're going to.
privacy.attendance_label: Who can see events I'm going to
privacy.att_nobody_desc: No one can see the events you're attending
privacy.att_friends_desc: Only your friends can see you're going
privacy.att_everyone_desc: Show me in the public "Who's going" list
privacy.attendance_note: This controls the "Who's going" section on events.
privacy.public_profile_desc: Let anyone view your profile, bio, and social links. When off, only friends can see them.
privacy.find_by_phone_desc: Let people who already have your number find you when they sync contacts. Your number is never shown.
privacy.suggest_me: Suggest me to people I may know
privacy.suggest_me_desc: Let people who share friends or events with you see you in friend suggestions, and let friends see that you are going. When off, you stay out of both.

social.title: Social & Bio
social.subtitle: Let people connect with you off Tikèm
social.bio_placeholder: Tell people a little about yourself
social.notice: These links are shown on your public profile exactly as you enter them. We don't verify account ownership.
social.save_error: Could not save. Please try again.
